youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用設置新手機情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從開機選語言、連 Wi-Fi、帳號移轉資料，到裝 App、設鬧鐘與隱私設定全部涵蓋。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多科技場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Setting Up a New Phone phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering power-on, Wi-Fi, account transfer, app installs, alarms and privacy settings. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life tech scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this your new phone?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I opened it this morning.
dialogue.zh: 對，我今天早上才剛拆封。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much battery is left?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only twenty percent, I think.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You should charge it first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, where is the cable?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The white cable is in the box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwaɪt ˈkeɪbəl ɪz ɪn ðə bɑks./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Found it, thanks for telling me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now press and hold this side button.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ prɛs ænd hoʊld ðɪs saɪd ˈbʌtən./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like this? Nothing is happening yet.
dialogue.zh: 這樣嗎？還沒有任何反應。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait a few more seconds.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, the logo just appeared!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It always takes a minute here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I will just watch it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A welcome screen came up now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It asks me to pick a language.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt æsks mi tu pɪk ə ˈlæŋɡwɪdʒ./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Choose the language you read best.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will take English, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then it wants your country.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I choose the United States?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pick the country where you live.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, the map shows my region.
dialogue.zh: 好了，地圖顯示了我的地區。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next is the keyboard layout.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What is the difference between them?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The first one is the common layout.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fɜrst wʌn ɪz ðə ˈkɑmən ˈleɪaʊt./
dialogue.zh: 第一種是最通用的配置。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I will keep that one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now press the blue continue button.
dialogue.zh: 現在按藍色的繼續按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It moved to the Wi-Fi page.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt muːvd tu ðə ˈwaɪ ˌfaɪ peɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 它跳到無線網路頁面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You need a network to continue.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Our home Wi-Fi should be nearby.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊr hoʊm ˈwaɪ ˌfaɪ ʃʊd bi ˌnɪrˈbaɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我們家的網路應該就在附近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tap the name of your network.
dialogue.zh: 點一下你家網路的名稱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see ours with strong signal.
dialogue.zh: 我看到我們的了，訊號很強。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now type the password carefully.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where can I find the password?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is printed under the router.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me check the small sticker.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Read it out loud, letter by letter.
dialogue.phonetic: /rid ɪt aʊt laʊd, ˈlɛtər baɪ ˈlɛtər./
dialogue.zh: 大聲念出來，一個字母一個字母。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Eight letters and two numbers.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Careful, that letter looks like a zero.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛrfəl, ðæt ˈlɛtər lʊks laɪk ə ˈzɪroʊ./
dialogue.zh: 小心，那個字母看起來像零。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, I typed the wrong symbol.
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，我打到錯的符號了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try again slowly this time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says connected at last.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The phone updates itself now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How long does that usually take?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe two or three minutes.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will wait beside you here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It found a new system version.
dialogue.zh: 它找到一個新的系統版本。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I install it right away?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, install it before anything else.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The screen just went dark.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is normal during updates.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I press any button?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, just let it work.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I will keep my hands off.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, aɪ wɪl kip maɪ hænz ɔf./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is restarting on its own.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The progress bar is almost full.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost there, do not worry.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, the screen is back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it asks for your name.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My name or the phone name?
dialogue.zh: 我的名字還是手機名稱？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The phone needs a friendly name.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will call it Blue Phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That name works just fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Next it wants an email address.
dialogue.zh: 接著它要電子郵件信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Use the email you check daily.
dialogue.zh: 用你每天都會看的信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have my old address here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Type it and press send code.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It sent a six digit code.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Enter the code from your email.
dialogue.zh: 輸入信箱收到的那組碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, my mail is on the old phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, maɪ meɪl ɪz ɑn ðə oʊld foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 等等，我的信還在舊手機上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then check the old phone quickly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it, the code matched.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The account is created now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It wants a password for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Make it long but easy for you.
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪk ɪt lɔŋ bʌt ˈizi fər ju./
dialogue.zh: 設長一點，但你要記得住。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can I just note it on paper?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ dʒʌst noʊt ɪt ɑn ˈpeɪpər?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, keep the note somewhere safe.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I wrote it in my paper book.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ roʊt ɪt ɪn maɪ ˈpeɪpər bʊk./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never save it inside the phone.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Understood, that feels safer anyway.
dialogue.zh: 懂了，那樣確實比較安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now set the date and time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can it do that by itself?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn on automatic time setting.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The clock shows the right time.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next is a screen lock code.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do I really need a code?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, it protects all your data.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, I will choose four numbers.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not use your birthday.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why not? That is easiest for me.
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ nɑt? ðæt ɪz ˈigest fər mi./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Anyone can guess a birthday.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, I will pick another one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Type it twice to confirm.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lock is finally turned on.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now pick your basic apps.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Which ones should I keep?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep messages and the camera app.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Those are both very useful.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The home screen is showing now.
dialogue.zh: 主畫面現在顯示出來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So empty, but it feels good.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Would you like to restore your data?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʊd ju laɪk tu rɪˈstɔr ˈjɔr ˈdeɪtə?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What does that question mean here?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It can copy things from your old phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kæn ˈkɑpi θɪŋz frʌm ˈjɔr oʊld foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 它能從你的舊手機複製東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That sounds perfect for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Choose the transfer option on screen.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It tells me to bring the old phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt tɛlz mi tu brɪŋ ði oʊld foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 它叫我把舊手機拿過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn the old one on now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is dead, the battery is empty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz dɛd, ðə ˈbætəri ɪz ˈɛmpti./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plug it in and wait a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /plʌɡ ɪt ɪn ænd weɪt ə bɪt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, ten minutes should be enough.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Meanwhile read these short steps.
dialogue.zh: 期間先看一下這些步驟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They say both phones need Wi-Fi.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ seɪ boʊθ foʊnz nid ˈwaɪ ˌfaɪ./
dialogue.zh: 上面說兩支都要連網路。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The old phone is already connected.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one just joined the same network.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn dʒʌst dʒɔɪnd ðə seɪm ˈnɛtwɜrk./
dialogue.zh: 這支也連上同一個網路了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now open the settings menu.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where exactly do I look?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tap general, then the transfer tool.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I found it under this heading.
dialogue.zh: 我在這個標題底下找到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Press start to begin the process.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A big number appeared on my screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bɪɡ ˈnʌmbər əˈpɪrd ɑn maɪ skriːn./
dialogue.zh: 我螢幕上跳出一個大數字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Point the old camera at it.
dialogue.zh: 用舊手機的相機對著它。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Like taking a photo of it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Exactly, just hold it steady.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says the code was accepted.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The two phones are finding each other.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə tu foʊnz ɑr ˈfaɪndɪŋ itʃ ˈʌðər./
dialogue.zh: 兩支手機正在互相尋找。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How long does that take normally?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: About a minute, sometimes two.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now it shows my phone name.
dialogue.zh: 它現在顯示我的手機名稱。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tap the name to connect them.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small spinner keeps turning.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not move either phone now.
dialogue.zh: 現在別移動任何一支手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will set them on the table.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl sɛt ðɛm ɑn ðə ˈteɪbəl./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep them close and plugged in.
dialogue.zh: 讓它們靠近，而且要插電。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both cables reach the outlet.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It asks what you want to copy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt æsks wʌt ju wɑnt tu ˈkɑpi./
dialogue.zh: 它問你想複製哪些東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can I choose only some things?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, check each box you need.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I want photos and contacts first.
dialogue.zh: 我優先要照片和聯絡人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Contacts are the most important.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have over three hundred names.
dialogue.zh: 我名單上有三百多個人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Notes can come along too.
dialogue.zh: 筆記也可以一起搬過去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And all of my calendar events.
dialogue.zh: 還有我行事曆裡的所有行程。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not forget your messages.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I keep the old chat history?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ kip ði oʊld tʃæt ˈhɪstəri?/
dialogue.zh: 舊的聊天紀錄要一起留嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only if you still need it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will leave the big files out.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl liv ðə bɪɡ faɪlz aʊt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That saves a lot of time.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Videos are the slowest part.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You can move those later.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So how do I move them?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A cloud folder handles video files.
dialogue.zh: 雲端資料夾會處理影片檔。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then let us skip them today.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Press continue to start the copy.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The bar shows only one percent.
dialogue.zh: 進度條才顯示百分之一。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This may take an hour.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: An hour? That feels long.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: More data takes more time.
dialogue.zh: 資料越多，要花的時間越久。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can I use the old one meanwhile?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ juːz ði oʊld wʌn ˈminˌwaɪl?/
dialogue.zh: 這段期間我能用舊的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, the old one must stay still.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ði oʊld wʌn mʌst steɪ stɪl./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I will read a book.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not close either screen.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I turn the brightness down?
dialogue.zh: 我要把亮度調低一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is fine, keep it low.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Both screens look much softer now.
dialogue.zh: 兩個畫面現在柔和多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twenty percent done already.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Time for a cup of tea?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, I will wait here.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do you want one too?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No sugar for me, thanks.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will be right back.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fifty percent, still going well.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The new phone is getting warm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Warm is normal during transfers.
dialogue.zh: 移轉過程中微熱很正常。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I unplug it a bit?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, let it finish the job.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, I will sit back down.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says almost done now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Finally, I thought it had stopped.
dialogue.zh: 終於，我還以為它卡住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set the new phone upright.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is it safe to touch now?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, just do not unplug it.
dialogue.zh: 可以，但別把充電線拔掉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The phone restarted one more time.
dialogue.zh: 手機又重新啟動了一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That last restart is expected.
dialogue.zh: 最後那次重啟是在預料中的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now it wants my password again.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Type the one you made earlier.
dialogue.zh: 輸入你早先設的那一組。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the note in my book.
dialogue.zh: 對，就是筆記裡記的那組。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your photos are loading.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can see grandma's birthday pictures.
dialogue.zh: 我看到奶奶生日的照片了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Contacts came through fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All of my work numbers are here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl ʌv maɪ wɜrk ˈnʌmbərz ɑr hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我工作的電話號碼全都在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check a few notes too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My grocery list is still saved.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything copied successfully.
dialogue.zh: 所有東西都複製成功了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is such a relief.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the old phone?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can I keep using it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, but sign out first.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where do I find that option?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: In settings, tap remove account.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, my data stays private.
dialogue.zh: 好了，我的資料不會外洩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us add some apps now.
dialogue.zh: 我們現在來裝一些應用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Where do I find the app store?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du aɪ faɪnd ði æp stɔr?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The blue icon is on this row.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə bluː ˈaɪkɑn ɪz ɑn ðɪs roʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It wants me to sign in again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wɑnts mi tu saɪn ɪn əˈɡɛn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Use the same account as before.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I do not need a new password.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, aɪ du nɑt nid ə nuː ˈpæswɜrd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Search for the messenger app.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I type its name right here?
dialogue.zh: 我在這裡打它的名字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the first result is correct.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It shows a big get button.
dialogue.zh: 它出現一個大大的取得按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tap it and wait a moment.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The download started already.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Open it when the icon appears.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It asks to allow notifications.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Allow them so you never miss messages.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈlaʊ ðɛm soʊ ju ˈnɛvər mɪs ˈmɛsɪdʒɪz./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sounds reasonable, I pressed allow.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now sign into your chat account.
dialogue.zh: 現在登入你的聊天帳號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My old phone had my number.
dialogue.zh: 我的電話號碼在舊手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Type the number with the country code.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪp ðə ˈnʌmbər wɪð ðə ˈkʌntri koʊd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It sent a code by text.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Enter those six digits here.
dialogue.zh: 把這六個數字輸入這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The account opened fine.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does it ask about restoring chats?
dialogue.zh: 它有問要不要還原對話？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, from a backup file.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Choose the backup from yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the newest one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Your group chats will come back.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hope my work group is there.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊp maɪ wɜrk ɡruːp ɪz ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 希望我的工作群組也在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is copying the message history.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This is faster than the phone transfer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɪz ˈfæstər ðæn ðə foʊn ˈtrænsfɜr./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Chats are smaller than photos.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That explains the speed.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us install the email app.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do I need both accounts?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add the work one and the personal one.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd ðə wɜrk wʌn ænd ðə ˈpɜrsənəl wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 工作和私人的都加進去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It asks for a server setting.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Choose automatic setup instead.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That worked, the mail is loading.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next the camera permissions.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Why does email need my camera?
dialogue.zh: 郵件為什麼需要我的相機？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It does not, you can say no.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt dʌz nɑt, ju kæn seɪ noʊ./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will only allow photos.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a smart choice.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I allow my location too?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only for apps that need maps.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The weather app wants it often.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pick while using the app.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Better than always sharing.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now add the banking app.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is that safe on a new phone?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt seɪf ɑn ə nuː foʊn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, use your usual password.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It also wants a face check.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set up face recognition for it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I have to move my head slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hæv tu muːv maɪ hɛd ˈsloʊli./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That scans your whole face.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says verified now.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you want social media?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The video app and the photo one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈvɪdioʊ æp ænd ðə ˈfoʊtoʊ wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 影片那個，還有照片那個。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both are in the second row.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: These app downloads are quite large.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Use Wi-Fi for big downloads.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My data plan is too small.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will pause the second app.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can it resume later?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, tap it again anytime.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us finish the music app first.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə ˈmjuːzɪk æp fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 我們先把音樂那個裝完。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sign in with your old username.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says wrong password here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Use the forgot password link.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The reset link came to my email.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈrisɛt lɪŋk keɪm tu maɪ ˈimeɪl./
dialogue.zh: 重設連結傳到我信箱了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pick a password you have not used.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɪk ə ˈpæswɜrd ju hæv nɑt juːzd./
dialogue.zh: 選一個你沒用過的密碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This random one is hard to remember.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈrændəm wʌn ɪz hɑrd tu rɪˈmɛmbər./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write it on the same note.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, the paper book again.
dialogue.zh: 好主意，又是那本紙筆記。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the login works.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My playlists are all still there.
dialogue.zh: 我的播放清單全都還在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us tidy the home screen.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How do I move an icon?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold your finger on it.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now I can drag it anywhere.
dialogue.zh: 現在我能把它拖到任何地方。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep daily apps on page one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Games belong on the last page.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That keeps things simple.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I delete anything I do not use?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ dɪˈliːt ˈɛniθɪŋ aɪ du nɑt juːs?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, unused apps take space.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How do I remove one?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Long press, then choose delete.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It asked me to confirm.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Confirm, the space comes back.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me put the case on now.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi pʊt ðə keɪs ɑn naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我現在就把保護殼裝上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You do not need the case yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju du nɑt nid ðə keɪs jɛt./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Actually I want to protect the screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈæktʃuəli aɪ wɑnt tu prəˈtɛkt ðə skriːn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This clear case fits perfectly.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It came with the phone box.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Go on, put the case on.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a scratch on the side.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə skrætʃ ɑn ðə saɪd./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That must be from the table.
dialogue.zh: 那應該是在桌上刮到的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It hardly shows under the case.
dialogue.zh: 裝上殼就幾乎看不出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The apps are all set now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just a few settings left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us pick a wallpaper.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can I use my own photo?
dialogue.zh: 我能用自己拍的照片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, open the photo gallery.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This sunset picture looks nice.
dialogue.zh: 這張夕陽的照片很好看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pinch it to fit the screen.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I use it on the lock screen?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ juːz ɪt ɑn ðə lɑk skriːn?/
dialogue.zh: 鎖定畫面也要用這張嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pick a lighter image there.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I can read the clock.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now choose a ringtone.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There are so many sound options.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try the short bell one.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is too loud for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The soft piano sounds calmer.
dialogue.zh: 輕柔鋼琴聽來比較安定。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I will keep that.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set the message tone as well.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should they be different sounds?
dialogue.zh: 兩個要用不同的聲音嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Different tones help you tell them apart.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdɪfərənt toʊnz hɛlp ju tɛl ðɛm əˈpɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 不一樣的音才分得出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good point, I chose a beep.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn the volume down a little.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My old phone was always too loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ oʊld foʊn wʌz ˈɔlˌweɪz tu laʊd./
dialogue.zh: 我舊手機永遠都太大聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set the vibration strength too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I like a strong buzz.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now for the morning alarm.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I need one for six thirty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pick the days you wake up.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only weekdays, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add a label to the alarm.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I write wake up early?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Write something that motivates you.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will type coffee is waiting.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That always works for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Does the alarm play music?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, choose a gentle song.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This quiet guitar piece is nice.
dialogue.zh: 這首輕聲的吉他曲滿好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add a second alarm later.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: For when? I might oversleep.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set it seven minutes after.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That gives me a small buffer.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn on dark mode now.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is that easier on the eyes?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, especially late at night.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, this is far better.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Schedule it to switch at sunset.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, no more bright screen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Increase the text size a bit.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A little larger helps me read.
dialogue.zh: 大一些我讀起來較不吃力。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not go too big.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The whole line would not fit.
dialogue.zh: 不然整行字都放不下去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try bold text instead.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That looks clearer on this page.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check the hearing settings.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a phone noise reduction.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn it on for calls.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My office is very noisy.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also enable live captions.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Captions for phone calls?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, it writes words as people speak.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt ˈraɪts wɜrdz æz ˈpipəl spik./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That seems useful in a cafe.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us test the speaker.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will call you from the old phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl kɔl ju frʌm ði oʊld foʊn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ring, can you hear me?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Your voice sounds very clear.
dialogue.zh: 你的聲音聽起來很清澈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now try the microphone.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Are you still recording?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, the sound bar is moving.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, the call quality is good.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check the find my phone setting.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Is it already switched on?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If not, turn it on now.
dialogue.zh: 如果還沒開，現在就打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What happens if I lose it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You can see the map location.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And lock the screen from far away?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd lɑk ðə skriːn frʌm fɑr əˈweɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 還能從遠處鎖定畫面嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, that protects your data.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How do I back things up?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set automatic cloud backup.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How often does it run?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every night while you charge.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then I will keep the charger nearby.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn aɪ wɪl kip ðə ˈtʃɑrdʒər ˌnɪrˈbaɪ./
dialogue.zh: 那我就把充電器放旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The old photos are in the cloud.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði oʊld ˈfoʊtoʊz ɑr ɪn ðə klaʊd./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Should I delete them from here?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only if you need storage.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is still plenty of space.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then keep everything visible.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The gallery is nice to browse.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Try the new camera features.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This night mode looks amazing.
dialogue.zh: 夜間模式的效果很驚豔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Take a photo of the lamp.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The result is very bright.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You can use slow motion too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let me film the cat.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is a good test clip.
dialogue.zh: 那段是很好的測試短片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He moved but the video is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi muːvd bʌt ðə ˈvɪdioʊ ɪz faɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything seems to work.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So glad the setup is done.
dialogue.zh: 很高興設定終於完成了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Want a quick tour of gestures?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, how do I go back?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Swipe from the left edge.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And to close an app?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Swipe up and hold.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This phone is growing on me.
dialogue.zh: 我越來越喜歡這支手機了。
